context: Tests the ADR lifecycle supersession workflow: when a prior architectural decision is being overturned, the agent must create a new ADR that explicitly references the superseded one, and update the original ADR's status to SUPERSEDED with a link to the replacement. Also tests correct sequential numbering when prior ADRs exist.

checklist.name: Old ADR status SUPERSEDED
checklist.description: The existing ADR for order storage (0003-use-mongodb-for-order-storage.md) has its status field changed to SUPERSEDED (not ACCEPTED)

checklist.name: Old ADR links to new
checklist.description: The updated existing ADR contains a reference or link to the new ADR filename (e.g. '0004-' appears somewhere in the file, or a 'Superseded by' note is added)

checklist.name: New ADR references superseded ADR
checklist.description: The new ADR references or links to the ADR it supersedes (e.g. mentions '0003' or the MongoDB ADR filename) in its body or frontmatter

checklist.name: Correct next sequence number
checklist.description: The new ADR filename begins with 0004 (the next sequential number after the three existing ADRs 0001, 0002, 0003)

checklist.name: Status PROPOSED in new ADR
checklist.description: The new ADR has status: PROPOSED in its YAML frontmatter (not ACCEPTED or DECIDED)

checklist.name: Authors and date in new ADR
checklist.description: The new ADR has both authors and date fields in its YAML frontmatter

checklist.name: Decision in active voice
checklist.description: The Decision section of the new ADR uses active voice, beginning with 'We will' or an equivalent first-person plural construction

checklist.name: At least two alternatives
checklist.description: The new ADR's Alternatives Considered section contains at least two distinct options with pros, cons, and rejection reasons

checklist.name: Consequences split into three subsections
checklist.description: The new ADR's Consequences section is divided into Positive, Negative, and Neutral subsections — all three present

checklist.name: No placeholder text
checklist.description: The new ADR does not contain unfilled template markers such as '[Driver 1]', '[Alternative 1]', 'TBD', or similar placeholder strings
